title: Catch Kitty 3D
description: Dive into a lively tumbling basket of cute kitties, toys, and treats—pluck matching trios into your tray before it fills up.
controls: Tap matching kitties and trinkets in the pile to collect three of a kind in your bottom slots; use booster props anytime.

zh-CN.title: 开心抓猫猫
zh-CN.description: 超萌抓大鹅同款堆叠找物三消：在满满一筐 Q 弹小猫与可爱杂货堆里眼疾手快揪出三个同款，配齐洗牌、回退与磁铁道具。
zh-CN.controls: 点击物品堆中的小猫或道具装入下方卡槽，凑齐三个同款立即消除，注意别让卡槽塞满。
